newsitem.title: USA: Goldman moves $250 million First Union block.
newsitem.headline: Goldman moves $250 million First Union block.

text.p: Goldman Sachs on Tuesday said it moved a $250 million block of First Union Corp shares sold by Banco Santander SA.
David Rogers, head of equity trading at Goldman, said Goldman bought a block of 5,214,000 shares of First Union from Banco Santander in off-exchange trading before the opening on Wall Street Tuesday.
He said the shares were then sold to institutional and regional holders.
The buyers paid 48-5/8 for the stock, off of a last sale Monday at 49-1/2, Rogers said.
Last year Banco Santander sold two large blocks of First Union shares through Goldman, a $151 million block in November, and a $230 million block in August, Goldman said.
First Union said Banco Santander's ownership of First Union common stock dropped to 7.12 percent from 7.96 percent before Tuesday's sale.
In May of this year Goldman moved the largest single block of shares when Kuwait sold shares in British Petroleum valued at $2 billion.
